description: Independent external review of a health insurance denial: what it is (a reviewer outside the insurer decides, and the plan pays if they side with the person), who can ask (not grandfathered plans), the four-month deadline computed from the final denial, the expedited version, and the regulation text verbatim. Example questions: what is an external review; how do I get an independent review of my denial; deadline for external review.

letter_date.description: Date printed on the final internal denial

received_date.description: Day the person actually received the letter, if they say

self_funded.description: Employer plan paid by the employer itself (often 'self-funded', 'claims administrator')

urgent.description: True only if the person or their doctor says waiting could seriously harm their health. Never infer it.

name: independent_external_review
title: Independent external review
